title: Child and Adult Portrait
coreRelationships: The child's face is the primary focal point, positioned centrally and looking out.
The adult's head and shoulder provide a supportive, partially obscured frame for the child.
The contrast between the child's lighter skin and the adult's darker hair creates visual separation.
The soft focus and graininess contribute to a nostalgic or intimate atmosphere.
